verdict.rationale: Mercury's invoicing pages say invoices can be created, sent and tracked, made recurring, and branded with a logo and colors. The Books pages confirm that invoicing data flows into the ledger automatically. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly covers online payment options for customers or notifications when an invoice is viewed or paid; 'track' is vague. Missing for 10: documented online payment methods (card/ACH pay links), view and paid status tracking or notifications, independent or hands-on corroboration.
